_comment: Release input for `node tools/v3-registration.mjs`. Copy this file, fill every <...> value from the real V3 deployment, and keep the receipt/transaction JSON next to it. The builder refuses any remaining placeholder. Nothing here has been deployed or registered.
_fromBlock: Decimal L2 blockNumber from the deployment receipt. Never Solidity block.number and never the receipt's l1BlockNumber.
_deploymentReceipt: Path (relative to this file) to the raw eth_getTransactionReceipt result, e.g. `cast receipt <tx> --json --rpc-url $ROBINHOOD_RPC`.
_deploymentTransaction: Path to the raw eth_getTransactionByHash result, e.g. `cast tx <tx> --json --rpc-url $ROBINHOOD_RPC`; proves chainId 4663.
_expectedRuntimeCodeHash: keccak256 of the frozen V3 artifact's deployed runtime with immutables accounted for; checked against `cast code` as a pre-broadcast gate.
label: HoodAggregatorV3
